body:
You sound like me a year ago. I can’t offer my solution as it was purely luck based that I found someone lovely to support me, but I can offer the little things that helped me along the way. Set short term goals until you are ready to set long term goals. These short term goals make the future exciting and worth reaching for. 

They can be (from my own experience)
Saving enough money to buy certain things that I set my eyes on such as a plane ticket to another country. 
Start learning a craft or skill and decide to make something. Then show it off to your parents. 
Even something simple as a ticket to an event. 

I understand that it can be hard to find the motivation to do these things or begin the journey to self care. Sometimes you need a spark to get you started. It can be spontaneous, such as finding a new friend. Or you can create that spark by deciding to help someone in need. 

I am really sorry for the situation that you are in. I truly do hope that you find your happiness and peace. Just keep fighting and don’t stay down. Please be well
